data.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
- Story consideration [Performance]: "Re-keying touches the hot path of every CI review cycle. Run the existing ledger micro-benchmarks (if present) and assert no >10% throughput regression."
- This task closes the gap identified by Step 6 gap-analysis: no other task validates the <10% regression requirement.

## Implementation Notes

1. **Locate or create baseline**: Check whether `tests/perf/` or similar exists with cycle_ledger benchmarks. If absent, create a minimal pytest-benchmark or timeit-based microbench targeting:
   - `append_cycle` (write path) — 1000 iterations, measure mean time per call
   - `reconstruct_from_pr_comments` (read path) — 1000 iterations against a fixture PR comment set of mixed v1.1.0 + v1.2.0 markers, measure mean time per reconstruction
2. **Capture baseline** by running the benchmark on cycle_ledger.py at the pre-S2 HEAD (use git stash or checkout to the parent commit if needed for measurement).
3. **Capture v1.2.0 result** by running the same benchmark on the post-S2 implementation.
4. **Assert <10% regression**: write the assertion into the benchmark script; commit both the script and the baseline numbers (under tests/perf/cycle_ledger_baseline.json or similar).
5. **CI-runnable**: ensure the benchmark can be invoked via the standard test runner (or a dedicated `make perf` target if one exists) so future re-runs catch regressions.

## File Impact

| Source file | Action | Associated tests | Test classification |
|-------------|--------|------------------|---------------------|
| `tests/perf/test-cycle-ledger-perf.py` (or .sh) | create | (this IS the benchmark) | needs-creation |
| `tests/perf/cycle_ledger_baseline.json` | create | n/a (baseline data) | n/a |

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Benchmark script exists and is runnable
  Verify: test -f tests/perf/test-cycle-ledger-perf.py || test -f tests/perf/test-cycle-ledger-perf.sh
- [ ] Baseline data captured
  Verify: test -f tests/perf/cycle_ledger_baseline.json
- [ ] Benchmark asserts <10% regression on append_cycle and reconstruct_from_pr_comments
  Verify: grep -E '0\\.1\\|10.*percent\\|< 1\\.1' tests/perf/test-cycle-ledger-perf.* 2>/dev/null | head -1

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet\xe2\x86\x92opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
